recentItems.title: Dr.Janardhana Chari About Acupressure Points For Constipation Problem | iDream Health Talks
recentItems.description:
Are you suffering from constipation, hard stools, bloating, or difficulty passing stools? Learn about commonly used acupressure points for constipation relief in this informative Telugu health video.

In this video, discover how acupressure techniques are traditionally used to support digestive comfort and bowel movements.

**Topics Covered:**
- Acupressure Points for Constipation Relief
- Pressure Points for Better Digestion
- Natural Ways to Support Bowel Movements
- Constipation Causes and Symptoms
- Acupressure Techniques Explained in Telugu
- Digestive Health and Gut Health Tips
- Home Care Tips for Constipation

మలబద్ధకం సమస్యతో బాధపడుతున్నారా? మలబద్ధకం తగ్గించడానికి ఉపయోగించే అక్యుప్రెషర్ పాయింట్స్ గురించి ఈ వీడియోలో తెలుసుకోండి. జీర్ణక్రియ, పేగుల ఆరోగ్యం, మలవిసర్జన సమస్యల గురించి ఉపయోగకరమైన సమాచారం తెలుసుకోండి.

**Important:** Acupressure is a complementary technique, and evidence for constipation relief is limited. Persistent constipation may require medical evaluation. Consult a healthcare professional for appropriate treatment.
